items.headline: Acumen Pharmaceuticals Announces Topline Results from Phase 2 ALTITUDE-AD Clinical Trial of Sabirnetug (ACU193) for the Treatment of Early Alzheimer's Disease; Trial Did Not Meet Primary Endpoint
items.why: Acumen's own release (GlobeNewswire, Oct 30, 2026, 07:00 ET) names NCT06335173: ALTITUDE-AD did not meet its primary endpoint (iADRS at 18 months, neither dose separated from placebo).

manual.summary: Phase 2 ALTITUDE-AD in early Alzheimer's disease did not meet its primary endpoint: neither the 35 mg/kg nor the 50 mg/kg dose separated from placebo on change in iADRS at 18 months, and key secondary endpoints including CDR-SB were not significant. Amyloid plaque reduction on PET was statistically significant at both doses. Acumen said it will stop developing sabirnetug and explore strategic options.
manual.guided_window: Oct 2026 (registry estimate); Acumen's Oct 26 release had guided November 2026
manual.note: Reported two days before Acumen's own November guidance. Release went out 07:00 ET, before the open.

items.rt_note: Independent red team 2026-11-18: source re-opened and read; action, date and name confirmed.

items.headline: Immunovant Announces Topline Results from Proof-of-Concept Study of IMVT-1402 in Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus
items.why: Row pointed at Roivant's parallel release; Immunovant's own release (Sep 23, 2026) names NCT06980805 and is the primary source. Period 1 did not reach statistical significance on CLASI-A at Week 12.

manual.summary: Proof-of-concept study in cutaneous lupus erythematosus (57 patients): the 12-week placebo-controlled Period 1 did not reach statistical significance on the primary endpoint, percent change in CLASI-A at Week 12. Immunovant reported numerical trends favoring the drug and a favorable safety profile, but said the result did not meet its internal bar and plans to stop development in CLE.
manual.note: Reported about a month before the registry's estimated completion. Period 1 topline only; Immunovant said it plans to stop development in CLE. Roivant issued a parallel release the same day.

items.rt_note: Red team 2026-11-18: date, trial and outcome confirmed; the note claimed later periods continue, which the release does not say, and the drug lacked its INN. Both fixed.
